'''''I, Jedi''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]]. It was first published in [[May]] [[1998]] by [[Bantam Spectra]]. The novel is set in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], and it follows [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and his quest to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in order to save his wife, [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax]].

The novel's plot is concurrent to [[Kevin J. Anderson]]'s [[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy|''Jedi Academy Trilogy'']], and revisits much of that story. ''I, Jedi'' also features several characters from Stackpole's [[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'']] comic book series.
